headline: Can you name the 4 lobes of the brain?
stat_note: on each side of the cerebrum
body:
Frontal: movement, thinking, learning
Parietal: makes sense of body signals
Temporal: memory, language, emotion
Occipital: vision

headline: The spleen in 6 odd numbers
body: About 1 in thick, 3 in wide, 5 in long, weighs about 7 oz, and lies between ribs 9 and 11. The rule rounds real sizes.

headline: Your Achilles is the strongest tendon
stat_note: your body weight in force it can support
body: It links your calf muscles to your heel bone (calcaneus) and is about 6 to 10 inches long in adults.
